name: meta-ads
description: Generate direct-response Facebook/Instagram ad copy for a brand in your Great Ads AI workspace — primary text, headlines, and descriptions grounded in that brand's real voice, guardrails, and proven winning patterns. Read-only and free: no credits billed, no AI provider keys of your own.

connectors.description: Great Ads AI hosted API. The skill reads your brand's voice/audience/guardrails so it can write on-brand copy — read-only, free, no credits billed. Generate the key in the Great Ads AI dashboard under Settings → Integrations → Connect to Claude.

vars.description: Your Great Ads AI workspace API key (starts with gaa_live_). A key with the default 'read' scope is enough — the skill never writes or generates.

setup.claude_code: Add both vars to ~/.config/great-marketing-ai/great-marketing-ai.env (the Connect-to-Claude dialog in the dashboard gives you a ready-to-paste block).
